# Rihla Global

Rihla Global is an India-based B2B exporter of green coffee beans for international buyers.

## Core offerings
- Indian green Arabica coffee: Plantation A, Plantation B, Plantation C, and Plantation Bulk.
- Indian green Robusta coffee: Robusta Parchment and Robusta Cherry grades.
- Indian specialty coffee: Monsooned Malabar and other lot-specific specialty coffees.

## Buyer information
- Minimum order quantity: 500 kg.
- Standard packing: 60 kg jute bags.
- GrainPro and hermetic liners are available on request.
- Buyers can request lot-specific details including grade, screen size, moisture, processing, and origin.

## Trust and compliance
Rihla Global publishes its business registrations and export documentation at https://www.rihlaglobal.com/certifications/.
